subject: english
question:
Choose the correct words to complete the sentence:

Despite the (1) _________ challenges they faced during their (2) ________ journey, the explorers remained determined to reach the (3) _________ of their expedition
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"numerous"** means existing in large numbers or many. (असंख्य)

 
 
• **Example: Numerous** stars can be seen in the night sky.
 
 
 
• The word **"perilous"** means full of danger or risk. (खतरनाक)
 
 
• **Example: **The hikers embarked on a **perilous** journey through the mountains.
 
 
 
• The word **"end"** means the final point of something in space or time; the conclusion. (अंत)
 
 
• **Example: **After months of hard work, they finally reached the** end **of their project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Extraordinary **(असाधारण): Very unusual or remarkable.

 
 
• **Example:** She has an extraordinary talent for painting.
 
 
 
• **Swift **(तेज़): Happening quickly or promptly.
 
 
• **Example: **The swift response from the emergency team saved many lives.
 
 
 
• **Midpoint** (मध्य बिंदु): The exact middle point.
 
 
• **Example:** The midpoint of the journey is marked by a small village.
 
 
 
• **Trivial **(तुच्छ): Of little value or importance.
 
 
• **Example: **He often gets distracted by trivial details.
 
 
 
• **Pleasant** (सुहाना): Giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment.
 
 
• **Example: **The weather was pleasant, perfect for a day out in the park.
 
 
 
• **Destination** (गंतव्य): The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.
 
 
• **Example: **After a long journey, they finally reached their destination.
 
 
 
• **Tedious** (उबाऊ): Too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous.
 
 
• **Example: **The tedious lecture made many students fall asleep.
 
 
 
• **Brief** (संक्षिप्त): Of short duration.
 
 
• **Example: **The meeting was brief and to the point.
 
 
 
• **Beginning** (आरंभ): The point in time or space at which something starts.
 
 
• **Example: **The beginning of the book is very captivating.
 
 

3c:Tada,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
